caption:
Our own galaxy blocks the view of a spiral 10 million light years away.

Meet IC 342. It sits behind the dust of the Milky Way.
This is infrared light. It shows a web of dust.
How do spiral arms form? Magnetic fields may help.

What the astronomers say: dust fooled old counts, and some thought the galaxy was thrown from our group.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA14402. Spitzer Space Telescope, infrared light.
